list.doc: List tags paginated by language. Reads the language from the Xlang input or falls back to the session language. Only 'zh', 'fr', and 'en' are accepted; any other value defaults to 'en'. Calls tag_list_by_lang stored procedure.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1.

Xlang.description: Language code for filtering tags. Accepted values: 'zh', 'fr', 'en'. Any other value falls back to 'en'. Falls back to session language if omitted.

returns.description: Paginated tag list from tag_list_by_lang stored procedure for the resolved language

get_by_name.doc: Search for tags by name with pagination. Calls tag_get_by_name stored procedure with the provided name and page number.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1.

returns.description: Paginated tag records matching the provided name from tag_get_by_name stored procedure

store.doc: Create or update a tag record. Resolves the tag identifier from hashtag input or falls back to id. Calls tag_save stored procedure with sys_id, tag id, lang_code array, type, and name. Returns the saved tag data on success. Throws INVALID_DATA if the tag ID is not found, or INTERNAL_ERROR for other failures.

serial.description: System serial ID of the tag for update operations. Defaults to 0 for new tag creation.

hashtag.description: Tag hashtag identifier. Used as the tag id if provided. Falls back to id if empty.

id.description: Tag ID used as fallback when hashtag is empty. Required if hashtag is not provided.

lang_code.description: JSON array string of language codes associated with this tag. Defaults to empty array string '[]'.

returns.description: Saved tag data from tag_save stored procedure on success

errors.message: Tag ID was not found in the system
errors.condition: tag_save returns data with error equal to ID_NOT_FOUND constant

errors.message: An internal server error occurred during tag save
errors.condition: tag_save returns empty data or an unexpected error

delete.doc: Delete a tag by its system serial ID. Calls tag_delete stored procedure with the serial number.

serial.description: System serial ID of the tag to delete

returns.description: Deletion confirmation data from tag_delete stored procedure
